snippet.title: Arms Dealer Simulator - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Arms Dealer Simulator is a simulation game, where you manage a massive arms distribution empire and everything from assembly lines to logistic operations.You pick contracts and prepare orders by buying necessary weapons, parts and ammunition. You will be building guns, organizing and packaging massive amounts of weaponry and delivering them with your own scalable logistics fleet to grow your empire.
